name: ad-lockout-list
description: R158.50.7f (2026-10-08) supersedes 1.0.4 catch-as-error anti-pattern. PS5.1 Get-WinEvent -FilterXml -ErrorAction Stop throws EventLogQueryException on 0 hits ('找不到任何与指定的选择条件匹配的事件。' on zh-CN Windows). 1.0.4 fed that into $lastErrorMessage + error_code=1, agent runner surfaced it via run.error, centre UI showed red/yellow rows for what is the normal idle state on most DCs. 1.0.5 uses -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue + @($raw).Count to recognize 0 hits as 'no 4740 events in 15min window — normal idle state' (events=@(), error_code=0, lastErrorMessage=null → status='success' per R158.50.7g). Real failures (ProviderMetadata / log unreadable) cause $raw=$null and are routed to the catch block (preserves R158.50.6 error_code=1 path). R158.49.1 callerComputerName regex + R158.50.7e cross-domain displayName + R158.52 per-event try/catch all preserved. R158.50.5 FilterXml still in effect. R158.50.6 stdout error field still wired. minVersion stays at 0.1.2 (R158.50.7e agent package-runner reads parsed.error).
